The '''Blasted Asteroid''' was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Blasted Asteroid]] commercial chain that operated on [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Its best [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] and [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] was the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Ceoloe]], who worked closely with [[Waroon Dak]], an [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] and regular customer.

==Description==
The Blasted Asteroid was a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] in the [[Blasted Asteroid]] commercial chain that was built on a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] deck level of [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]], located in the [[Besh Gorgon system/Legends|Besh Gorgon system]] of the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. The dingy establishment was a favorite amongst regular visitors to the Wheel and so was often filled with customers, who were catered for by a team of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] who cleaned and worked in the cantina. The cantina discouraged fighting, and the staff was quick to call the [[Wheel Security Force]] if a scuffle began.<ref name="BTR" />

==History==
The establishment was in business during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], at which time the cantina's best [[Bouncer (occupation)/Legends|bouncer]] and [[Bartender/Legends|bartender]] was a muscular [[Human/Legends|Human]] named [[Ceoloe]], who was normally able to break up any fights. In such fights, Ceoloe particularly looked to protect [[Waroon Dak]], a [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Information broker/Legends|infochant]] who paid the bouncer a small finder's fee to regularly use a table by the bar for his work, as well as for tips as to potential sources of information.<ref name="BTR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Blasted Asteroid cantina was first introduced in ''[[Beyond the Rim]]'', an adventure module written by [[Sterling Hershey]] in [[2013]] for the [[Fantasy Flight Games]] [[Star Wars Roleplaying|roleplaying game]] system ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''. The cantina was one location player characters could potentially visit while searching for information during the first episode of the adventure.<ref name="BTR" />
